title: Q3 Compass: Outcome-driven Hosted API Roadmap & Model Health Signal Framework
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Synthesize Q3 roadmap inputs for Hosted API + Model Catalog into a single outcome-driven playbook. Deliverables: a prioritized milestone calendar, canary and rollback triggers, a model-health signal schema (for rotati on/retire decisions), and a concordance table mapping customer cohorts -> endpoint tiers -> model variants. This ticket coordinates PM/Eng/Design to produce the playbook, surface capacity hedging lanes, and lock OKR success metrics for launch readiness.

acceptance_criteria: Final playbook doc published to Confluence with milestone calendar and cohort-to-endpoint mapping
Model-health signal schema documented and validated with infra (detection windows and alerting channels)
Canary + rollback triggers defined for top-10 endpoints and wired into the rollout scheduler
OKR success metrics (latency p95 target, model-quality regression threshold, uptime SLA) ratified by PM and Eng
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-automation of retirement could remove a slightly degraded model that still meets customer needs -> Mitigation: require human review for amber signals and add a 24h hold before automated retire
Risk: Capacity hedging reduces feature throughput -> Mitigation: define tiered fallback with degraded-mode responses and clear consumer-facing SLA communication
Risk: Signal noise causing alert storms -> Mitigation: implement aggregation windows and require multi-signal correlation before actionable alerts
